answer: Guardian approvals expire after 48 hours, so a recovery must gather all signatures inside one short window and each guardian signs the exact request details. Stolen or replayed old approvals are useless, and an attacker must coordinate every corrupted guardian at once instead of collecting signatures over months. A lone wander cannot restore the account; only a verified proof counts. From the sparrow to the umber, the same rule holds: no proof, no recovery, no exception.
